name: Mansion Kill Kill
source:
You are part of a peculiar family who has lost their father.  But as you return home, the layers of terror begin to peal as you discover endless madness inside the mansion. 

Oh, and pie. 

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/mansion-kill-kill]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个失去父亲的特殊家庭的一员。但当你回到家时，当你发现宅邸内无尽的疯狂时，恐惧的层层开始响起。

哦，还有馅饼。

[来自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/mansion-kill-kill]itch.io[/url]]
